sources.entry: Simplenote - Simplest way to keep notes.

summary.one_liner: Simplenote for macOS is the open-source native macOS client for the Simplenote note-taking service, built in Swift and syncing through Simperium.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Simplenote client for macOS and points to Simplenote.com for product information. It covers developer setup: building with Xcode 12 or newer (Swift 5), installing third-party tools via a `rake dependencies` command, and opening the project with `rake xcode` or the `Simplenote.xcworkspace` file. Sync runs on the Simperium protocol, and credentials are generated at build time from either internal production credentials or user-supplied values from a committed template. The README also explains why Sparkle is not fetched through Swift Package Manager, and it notes that SwiftLint runs during builds and that commits should have no lint issues. Contribution and style guidance refers to the WordPress iOS style guidelines and a separate Contributing Guide.
use_cases: Build Simplenote for macOS from source
Contribute code to a Swift macOS notes app
Run a development build of a macOS note-taking app
Review Swift and SwiftLint conventions in a real app
how_to_run: Run `rake dependencies` to install or update third-party tools
Run `rake xcode` to prepare dependencies and launch the project in Xcode
Alternatively, open Simplenote.xcworkspace directly in Xcode
Internal contributors can run `bundle exec fastlane run configure_apply` to decrypt production credentials
notable: Native macOS Simplenote client written in Swift
Build-time credential generation with an external-contributor template
Sparkle integration script kept outside Swift Package Manager
Enforces SwiftLint style with no-warning commit policy
caveats: The README says Simperium is not accepting new accounts at this time
Sharing and publishing features do not work in development builds
Build fails unless production or user-specified credentials are provided
